name: Letter to the Galatians
description: A quiz on the Letter to the Galatians — faith, freedom, the Spirit, and life in Christ. 21 questions across 6 difficulty levels.
author: Bible Millionaire Team

questions.text: Who wrote the letter to the Galatians?
What is the first fruit of the Spirit listed in Galatians 5:22?
"Whatever a man sows, that he will also …" — how does Galatians 6:7 complete this?
For what did Christ set us free, according to Galatians 5:1?
Who believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness, according to Galatians 3:6?
How should believers restore someone caught in a sin, according to Galatians 6:1?
What does Paul say avails anything in Christ Jesus in Galatians 5:6?
To what were the Galatians called, yet warned not to use as an opportunity for the flesh? (Galatians 5:13)
How many years before the law was the promise given to Abraham, according to Galatians 3:17?
Which apostle did Paul oppose to his face in Antioch, according to Galatians 2:11?
What role did the law serve until Christ came, according to Galatians 3:24?
In Galatians 2:20 Paul says "I have been crucified with Christ." Who now lives in him?
In the allegory of Galatians 4, Hagar and Sarah represent two covenants. Which does Hagar represent?
After how many years did Paul go up to Jerusalem again, according to Galatians 2:1?
According to Galatians 3:28, what distinctions are abolished in Christ?
What would the Galatians have done for Paul, according to Galatians 4:15?
options: Plucked out their eyes and given them to him

questions.text: How did Paul receive the gospel he preached, according to Galatians 1:11–12?
What does Paul rebuke the Galatians for observing in Galatians 4:10?
According to Galatians 1:13–14, what did Paul do before his conversion?
options: Persecuted the church and tried to destroy it

questions.text: In what alone does Paul boast, according to Galatians 6:14?
Galatians 3:13 quotes an Old Testament verse: "Cursed is everyone who is hanged on a tree." Where does this come from?
